payload.summary: Every charge Norwich City Council makes in 2026-27, from garden waste collections to burials, in one long PDF. The table headed “Alcohol / Entertainment / Late night refreshment” is the one that matters here: application fees run from £100 for the smallest rateable-value band up to £1,905 for the largest venue selling drink, and annual charges from £70 to £1,050. The document lists the amounts without saying who sets them; for alcohol licensing they come from national regulations rather than from the council.
